title: Facet narration timing
description: When each narration line and word is spoken. The voice tools (edge_tts, piper_tts, openai_tts, elevenlabs_tts) write it when called with lines and a timing_path: one clip per line, each timed and joined with its pause into one narration file. edge_tts gives real word timings; the other voices spread the words over each line. Supplied speech has no synthesis timing, so write its transcript in this shape yourself: source transcript, one line per transcript segment, and the words spread over each line when the transcript has no word times. Cuts timed by lines, the composition's captions, subtitle_gen, plan_check and output_review follow it. Times are seconds from the start of the file.

source.description: synthesis: written by a voice tool. transcript: the timing of supplied speech, taken from its transcript.

voice.description: Who spoke the narration: the voice tool and voice for synthesis (required then); for a transcript, the speaker when known.
The voice name or id the tool used; for a transcript, the speaker.

file.description: The narration audio: the assembled file for synthesis, the supplied recording for a transcript.

id.description: The line id from the script (l1, l2 and so on); cuts name it in lines.

file.description: The line's own clip, for synthesis.

words.description: Every word in order, with its time; the composition's captions show them.

line.description: Id of the line the word belongs to.
